journal.plugin.name: Journal
journal.tool.instructions: Read the days with read_days before you change the journal, and pass back each day’s version, and the id of the entry you change, with every change.
journal.tool.read_days: Read the person’s journal, one day or a range: each day’s page as Markdown, with its version. Read before any change, and pass that version back with it. One call reads at most 31 days and 60000 characters; when the range doesn’t fit, the answer says where to read on.
journal.tool.read_days.from: The first day to read, YYYY-MM-DD.
journal.tool.read_days.to: The last day to read, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out to read one day.
journal.tool.add_entry: Add a new entry to a day: a heading with its time, its time and a title, or a title alone, then the text as its body. With a time it goes in time order; with none it goes at the end of the day. Makes the day’s page if it has none. Pass the day’s version from read_days to be sure it hasn’t changed since; leave it out to add to the day as it is now.
journal.tool.add_entry.time: The entry’s time, HH:MM on a 24-hour clock. Leave it out for an entry with no time; it then needs a title.
journal.tool.add_entry.title: A short title for the entry, on one line. Needed when there is no time; leave it out otherwise for none.
journal.tool.add_entry.version: The day’s version from read_days, or null if it had no page. Leave it out to add without checking.
journal.tool.replace_block: Replace one block (a paragraph, a list or a quote) with new writing. Name it by the day, its entry’s id and its whole text as read_days showed them, with the day’s version. An entry’s heading is a block too: replacing it changes the entry’s time or title.
journal.tool.replace_block.text: The new writing in Markdown. For a heading: ## HH:MM, ## HH:MM · Title, or ## Title for an entry with no time.
journal.tool.delete_block: Remove one block, named as for replace_block: the day, its entry’s id, its whole text and the day’s version.
journal.tool.insert_after: Add new writing right after one block, under the same entry, as a block of its own. To add an item to a list, use replace_block with the whole list instead. Name the block as for replace_block.
journal.tool.field.entry: The id of the block’s entry, as read_days lists it under the day (like 3fa2c1d0-0).
journal.tool.field.block: The block’s whole text, exactly as read_days showed it.
journal.tool.field.nth: Which match to change when several blocks under the entry have that text, counting from 1 at the top.
journal.tool.field.future: Pass true only when the person asked you to write on a day after today. Leave it out otherwise.
journal.tool.field.writing: Writing in Markdown: paragraphs, lists (- [ ] for a to-do) and quotes. No headings.
journal.read.problems: This page breaks the journal’s rules, so the tools can’t change it until its file is fixed:
journal.read.entries: Its entries, each with the id a change names it by:
journal.read.next: That is as much as one read holds. Read on from {next}.
journal.refusal.input: The field “{field}” is missing, isn’t one this tool takes, or isn’t in the form its description gives. Fix it and call again.
journal.refusal.dates:
A range must run forwards and cover at most {max} days.
Fix the dates and call again.
journal.refusal.stale: This day changed since you read it. Read it again with read_days, then make your change against what is there now.
journal.refusal.no-page: {title} has no page yet. Start it with add_entry.
journal.refusal.no-entry: {title} has no entry with the id {entry}. Read the day again with read_days and use an id it lists.
journal.refusal.untimed: An entry with no time needs a title, on one line, that doesn’t start with a time. Pass a title, or a time.
journal.refusal.no-block: No block under entry {entry} of {title} has exactly that text. Copy the block whole from read_days and call again.
journal.refusal.ambiguous: That text matches {count} of the blocks under entry {entry}. Pass nth, from 1 to {count}, to say which, counting from the top.
journal.refusal.entry-exists: {title} already has an entry at {time}. Add to it with insert_after, or pick another time.
journal.refusal.future: {title} is after today ({today}), so nothing was saved. If the person asked for that day, call again with future: true. If not, write on today’s page.
journal.refusal.heading: Writing can’t add a heading here. Start a new entry with add_entry, and replace a heading only with another: ## HH:MM, ## HH:MM · Title, or ## Title.
journal.refusal.date-heading: The date line comes from the page’s date and can’t be changed. Leave it as it is.
journal.refusal.rules: That would break the page’s rules, so nothing was saved: {problems}
journal.refusal.malformed: The page for {title} breaks the journal’s rules, so the tools can’t change it: {problems} Fix the file .journal/{path} with your file tools, then read the day again.
journal.refusal.too-big: The page for {title} is too big for the tools to read or change: a page holds up to {max} KB and {blocks} blocks. Ask the person what to do before you touch the file .journal/{path}.
journal.refusal.tool: The journal has no tool called {name}.
journal.chip.gone: This part of the journal changed or went, so it can’t be sent.
journal.chip.too-long: That is more of the journal than one message can carry. Pick fewer days.
journal.problem.dates-range: Dates must run forwards and cover at most {max} days.
journal.problem.pages-limit: Ask for 1 to {max} pages at a time.
journal.problem.caller: Only the person can use this.
journal.problem.method: This part of the journal doesn’t take that request.
journal.problem.failed: The journal couldn’t read or save this day. Try again.
journal.problem.unreadable: The edit could not be read.
journal.problem.entry-time:
An entry needs a time like 21:30.
Its title is optional and must fit on one line.
journal.problem.entry-untimed: An entry with no time needs a title, on one line, that doesn’t start with a time.
journal.problem.changed: This part of the page changed after you opened it, so your edit was not saved.
journal.problem.undo-changed: This part has changed since, so it can’t be undone.
journal.problem.no-page: This day’s page no longer exists.
journal.problem.date-heading: The date comes from the page itself and can’t be edited.
journal.problem.heading: Writing can’t add a heading. To start a new entry, use Add an entry.
journal.problem.entry-heading-form: An entry’s heading is a time, a time and a title, or a title alone.
journal.problem.entry-exists: There is already an entry at {time}. Add to that one, or pick another time.
journal.problem.malformed: This page breaks the journal’s rules, so it can’t be changed here. Fix the file itself first.
journal.problem.too-big: This page is too big to open here. A page holds up to {max} KB.
journal.problem.would-be-too-big: That would make this page too big to save. A page holds up to {max} KB.
journal.problem.edit-too-big: That change is too big to save in one go. Save it in smaller parts.
journal.problem.not-a-file: This page isn’t a plain file, so it can’t be read.
journal.problem.line-ends: Lines must end with a plain newline.
journal.problem.html: A journal page can’t hold HTML.
journal.problem.entry-heading: “{text}” isn’t an entry heading; it must be “## HH:MM”, “## HH:MM · Title” or “## Title”.
journal.problem.outside-entry: Writing must sit under an entry’s time.
journal.problem.body-kind: An entry holds paragraphs, lists and quotes, not {kind}.
journal.view.range.label: Days shown
journal.view.bar.label: Writing
journal.view.bar.title: Add title
journal.view.bar.noTimeHint: Leave the time off; the title names this entry
journal.view.day.broken: This page can’t be changed here until its file is fixed:
journal.view.write.title: Title
journal.view.write.untimed: An entry with no time needs a title that doesn’t start with a time.
journal.view.write.inexact: This can’t be saved exactly as it looks, so nothing was saved.
journal.view.write.linkSelect: Select the words to link first.
journal.view.write.linkAddress: A link needs an address that starts with https://.
journal.view.clash.gone: It is no longer on the page.
journal.view.clash.changed: This part just changed on the page. Your words are still here.
journal.view.clash.around: The page changed round this while you were writing.
journal.view.undo.changed: Can’t undo: that part has changed since.
journal.view.chip.unsaved: Save this first; then it can go to the chat.
journal.view.leave.heading: Your writing wasn’t saved
journal.view.leave.slow: Saving it is taking too long.
journal.view.unreachable: The journal couldn’t be reached. Try again in a moment.
journal.view.unreadable: The journal gave an answer it can’t read. Try again in a moment.
